issues.description: Meal constructor signature/order is inconsistent: the problem statement/UML specifies `Meal(String, String[])` (name first), but the template defines `public Meal(String[] ingredients, String name)`, while the solution defines `public Meal(String name, String[] ingredients)`. Students following the specification will instantiate Meal with (name, ingredients) and will get compilation errors against the provided template.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template constructor to match the spec/solution: `public Meal(String name, String[] ingredients)` and keep field assignments consistent; update any example/commented usage accordingly.
